key_points: Barry Diller's People Inc. withdrew its $18 bn takeover bid, sending MGM shares down ~9%
The bid withdrawal is a material M&A event, but not a fundamental change to MGM's long‑term cash‑flow profile
Analysts note MGM remains undervalued (≈17% discount to intrinsic value) and may revisit a deal later
Mizuho cut its price target following the withdrawal, reinforcing near‑term downside pressure
Short‑term sentiment is negative; medium‑term outlook remains neutral pending new catalyst
